query.description: Device 의 측정 항목 목록 (등록 순)
query.commandtext: SELECT ET_ITEM_SEQ, ITEM_NAME, PARA_NAME, COND_VALUE, CHAIN_NAME, CHAIN_NAME2, UNIT, TEST_NO, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER, ET_ITEM_SEQ

query.description: Limit 설정 화면: 측정 항목이 있는 Device 목록 (Factory 별)
query.commandtext: SELECT DEVICE_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory GROUP BY DEVICE_ID ORDER BY DEVICE_ID

query.description: Para Setup: 등록 Parameter 가 있는 Device + 공정 목록 (2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: SELECT DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, COUNT(*) AS PARA_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND TEST_PROGRAM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM ORDER BY DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM

query.description: 등록 Parameter 목록 + GDS Chain(Chain 1, 사용자 입력) + Spec 요약 + 값 있는 파일 수 (업로드 계획 / 조회 창). 2026-10-14 대표 Chain 조인 삭제
query.commandtext: SELECT I.ET_ITEM_SEQ, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.MEAS_TYPE, I.PARA_NAME, I.COND_VALUE, I.CHAIN_NAME, I.CHAIN_NAME2, I.FORCE_LEG, I.FORCE_LEG2, I.CHAIN_TYPE, I.UNIT, I.TEST_NO, I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.USE_FLAG, I.REG_SOURCE, I.REG_FILE_NAME, I.REMARK, I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_SPEC, SN.LOWER_LIMIT, SN.UPPER_LIMIT, SN.ENABLE_FLAG, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT V.SRC_FILE_SEQ) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V WHERE V.ET_ITEM_SEQ = I.ET_ITEM_SEQ) AS FILE_COUNT, NVL(I.UPDATE_USER, I.CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, NVL(I.UPDATE_TIME, I.CREATE_TIME) AS UPDATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT SN ON SN.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND SN.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND SN.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND SN.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_NAME WHERE I.FACTORY = :factory AND I.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND I.TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program ORDER BY I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.ITEM_NAME

query.description: Para 설정 화면: 등록 Parameter + GDS Chain + Spec (2026-10-14, 같은 날 값 통계 열은 화면에서 쓰지 않아 삭제)
query.commandtext: WITH L AS (SELECT S.ITEM_NAME, S.LOWER_LIMIT, S.UPPER_LIMIT, S.ENABLE_FLAG, S.UNIT, S.SPEC_TEXT, NVL(S.UPDATE_USER, S.CREATE_USER) AS SPEC_USER, NVL(S.UPDATE_TIME, S.CREATE_TIME) AS SPEC_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT S WHERE S.FACTORY = :f1 AND S.DEVICE_ID = :d1 AND S.TEST_PROGRAM = :t1) SELECT I.ET_ITEM_SEQ, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.MEAS_TYPE, I.PARA_NAME, I.COND_VALUE, I.CHAIN_NAME, I.CHAIN_NAME2, I.UNIT AS ITEM_UNIT, I.TEST_NO, I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.USE_FLAG, I.REG_SOURCE, I.REG_FILE_NAME, I.REMARK, I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME, CASE WHEN L.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_SPEC, L.LOWER_LIMIT, L.UPPER_LIMIT, L.ENABLE_FLAG, NVL(L.UNIT, I.UNIT) AS UNIT, L.SPEC_TEXT, CASE WHEN L.SPEC_TIME > NVL(I.UPDATE_TIME, I.CREATE_TIME) THEN L.SPEC_USER ELSE NVL(I.UPDATE_USER, I.CREATE_USER) END AS UPDATE_USER, GREATEST(NVL(I.UPDATE_TIME, I.CREATE_TIME), NVL(L.SPEC_TIME, NVL(I.UPDATE_TIME, I.CREATE_TIME))) AS UPDATE_TIME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I LEFT JOIN L ON L.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_NAME WHERE I.FACTORY = :f2 AND I.DEVICE_ID = :d2 AND I.TEST_PROGRAM = :t2 ORDER BY I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.ITEM_NAME

query.description: Para 등록 검사: Device + 공정의 등록 Parameter 이름 / 원문 / 단위 (2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: SELECT ET_ITEM_SEQ, ITEM_NAME, HEADER_TEXT, UNIT, USE_FLAG FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program

INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM (ET_ITEM_SEQ, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, ITEM_NAME, HEADER_TEXT, PARA_NAME, COND_VALUE, MEAS_TYPE, CHAIN_NAME, CHAIN_NAME2, CHAIN_TYPE, FORCE_LEG, FORCE_LEG2, UNIT, TEST_NO, DISPLAY_ORDER, USE_FLAG, REG_SOURCE, REG_FILE_NAME, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (ET_ITEM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, :factory, :device_id, :test_program, :item_name, :header_text, :para_name, :cond_value, :meas_type, :chain_name, :chain_name2, :chain_type, :force_leg, :force_leg2, :unit, TO_NUMBER(:test_no), TO_NUMBER(:display_order), 'Y', :reg_source, :reg_file_name, :create_user, SYSDATE, :update_user, SYSDATE)

query.description: Para 설정 저장: 사용 여부 / 비고 / GDS Chain (수정된 행만, UpdateExecuteMultiple 1회, 2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM SET USE_FLAG = :use_flag, REMARK = :remark, GDS_CHAIN_NAME = :gds_chain_name, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND ITEM_NAME = :item_name

query.description: Para 설정 오른쪽 목록: GDS Device 의 Setup Chain (ACTIVE + 현재 READY 버전) (2026-10-14, 대표 Chain XML 에서 옮김)
query.commandtext: SELECT C.CHAIN_SEQ, C.CHAIN_CODE, V.CHAIN_NAME FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN C JOIN TQP_GDS_CHAIN_VER V ON V.FACTORY = C.FACTORY AND V.DEVICE_ID = C.DEVICE_ID AND V.CHAIN_SEQ = C.CHAIN_SEQ AND V.IS_CURRENT = 1 WHERE C.FACTORY = :factory AND C.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND C.CHAIN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND V.VERSION_STATUS = 'READY' ORDER BY V.CHAIN_NAME, C.CHAIN_CODE

query.description: 인계 API GetEtChainSpecInfo: GDS Chain 이름(대소문자 무시)을 GDS Chain 으로 넣은 모든 공정 등록 Parameter + Spec. Device = GDS Device 와 이름이 같은(대소문자 무시) E-Test Device (2026-10-15 Sub Device 연결 제거)
query.commandtext: SELECT I.DEVICE_ID, I.TEST_PROGRAM, I.ITEM_NAME, I.HEADER_TEXT, I.CHAIN_NAME, I.CHAIN_NAME2, I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME, I.UNIT, I.USE_FLAG, CASE WHEN SN.ITEM_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HAS_SPEC, SN.LOWER_LIMIT, SN.UPPER_LIMIT, SN.ENABLE_FLAG, SN.SPEC_TEXT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT SN ON SN.FACTORY = I.FACTORY AND SN.DEVICE_ID = I.DEVICE_ID AND SN.TEST_PROGRAM = I.TEST_PROGRAM AND SN.ITEM_NAME = I.ITEM_NAME WHERE I.FACTORY = :factory AND I.TEST_PROGRAM IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(I.DEVICE_ID) = UPPER(:device_id) AND UPPER(I.GDS_CHAIN_NAME) = UPPER(:gds_chain_name) ORDER BY I.TEST_PROGRAM, I.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.ITEM_NAME

query.description: Parameter 삭제 전 확인: Device + 공정에서 측정값이 저장된 Parameter 와 값 수 (한 번에 조회, 2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: SELECT I.ITEM_NAME, COUNT(*) AS VALUE_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM I JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V ON V.ET_ITEM_SEQ = I.ET_ITEM_SEQ WHERE I.FACTORY = :factory AND I.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND I.TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program GROUP BY I.ITEM_NAME

query.description: 등록 Parameter 삭제 (측정값이 없을 때만, DeleteExecuteMultiple 1회, 2026-10-14)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND ITEM_NAME = :item_name
